title: Crispy Beef and Kidney Piadina Rolls
description: A simple Italian-inspired snack or appetizer made with crispy piadina, zesty beef, and tender kidney.
instructions: Cut the piadina sheets in half.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced kidney and cook until browned.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Stir in the zesty sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Assemble the piadina rolls by placing a spoonful of the beef and kidney mixture on each half.
Roll up the piadina and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
